context.image_generation_policy: Prefer product-specific generated artwork when available; retain deterministic code-native assets as the build-safe fallback.
context.market: Independent residential service contractors with 2 to 20 employees that receive estimate requests through calls, texts, email, and web forms
context.outcome: Turn each inbound service request into a complete, assigned, customer-visible quote package with site details, photos, scope notes, and an explicit quote-ready decision
context.primary_user: The office coordinator or owner who qualifies incoming work and schedules estimators without replacing the company's accounting or dispatch system

definition_of_done: Landscape 1200x630, square 1200x1200, and story 1080x1920 images express the product's actual visual language.
Open Graph and X cards have a title, description, canonical URL, image, dimensions, and accessible alt text.
Search metadata includes a concise title and description, canonical URL, robots directive, and truthful page-specific JSON-LD.
Public copy uses researched intent phrases visibly; the obsolete meta keywords tag is absent.
Platform-ready captions and hashtags are truthful, product-specific, and retained in launch-assets/social-copy.json.
sitemap.xml and robots.txt are generated from the deployed request origin.

When frontend/vercel.json declares outputDirectory out, preserve static export: generate sitemap.xml and robots.txt through frontend/scripts/prepare-static-deployment.mjs and do not add getServerSideProps pages.

Live rich-preview, image, sitemap, robots, and rendered metadata evidence is retained after deployment; for a local-only canary with deployment explicitly unauthorized, retain these as live_evidence_pending and do not block local verification.
forbidden_scope: unsupported customer, revenue, performance, or ranking claims
task.objective: Make the product recognizable, shareable, and indexable without unsupported claims or generic placeholder artwork.
task.title: Generate and verify QuoteRivet social and search assets
